title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On this coordinate system, draw a two-dimensional sketch by creating a new face. Within this face, draw a closed loop consisting of four straight lines. The first line starts at the origin and ends at coordinates [0.0137, 0.0]. The second line starts from the endpoint of the first line and extends to [0.0137, 0.0312]. The third line continues from there to [0.0, 0.0312], and the fourth line completes the loop back to the origin. After drawing the loop, apply a scale factor of 0.0312 to the entire sketch. Ensure that the sketch remains aligned with the original coordinate system by setting the rotation angles to zero and the translation vector to zero. To transform this two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the direction of the normal. Do not extrude in the opposite direction. This process will generate a new solid body, which is a rectangular prism with a flat top and bottom. The dimensions of this rectangular prism are as follows: length of 0.013671875 units, width of 0.03125 units, and height of 0.7500000000000001 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0137, 0).lineTo(0.0137, 0.0312).lineTo(0, 0.0312).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane in the XZ plane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the first sketch
first_sketch = (
    wp.moveTo(0, 0.0043)
    .threePointArc((0.0013, 0.0013), (0.0043, 0))
    .lineTo(0.0269, 0)
    .threePointArc((0.0299, 0.0013), (0.0312, 0.0043))
    .lineTo(0.0312, 0.0094)
    .threePointArc((0.0299, 0.0124), (0.0269, 0.0137))
    .lineTo(0.0043, 0.0137)
    .threePointArc((0.0013, 0.0124), (0, 0.0094))
    .lineTo(0, 0.0043)
    .close()
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = first_sketch.extrude(0.75)
